# Deduplicated per calendar month via oe_bem_ran_m (Slot 57) and oe_bem_ran_m_3 (Slot 58); rebel-guarded per fx17.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_bem_fallback_pulse } }

oe_bem_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        is_rebel_country = no
        OR = {
            AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
            tag = ROM
        }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                current_year >= 1560
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_act2_done }
                NOT = { global_var:oe_bem_ran_m ?= oe_bem_m_now }
            }
            AND = {
                current_year >= 1730
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_done }
                NOT = { global_var:oe_bem_ran_m_3 ?= oe_bem_m_now }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_ml_mark_start = yes
        if = {
            limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year >= 1560 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_act2_done } }
                oe_bem_act12_monthly = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year >= 1730 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_done } }
                oe_bem_act3_monthly = yes
            }
        }
    }
}
